_what: The research system as one repeatable process, the same for every brand and every avatar. `access` is what a brand grants so the research can run on its own accounts; `steps` is the fill, in order. fill.py reads this file; change the process here, never in code.

access.name: Scraping account
access.unlocks: rooms, outside research for the profile, research rounds
access.grant: the brand's own Apify token, on the setup page

access.name: Ad comments
access.unlocks: what people say under the brand's ads
access.grant: the brand's own ads database (DATABASE_URL), or its Meta ad account in operations/brand.json for a paid scrape of its top ads

access.name: Support inbox
access.unlocks: customers' own words from support tickets
access.grant: which helpdesk it uses in operations/brand.json (accounts.helpdesk), read through its ads database

access.name: Store reviews
access.unlocks: verified buyers' words, with star ratings
access.grant: the review app (Junip or Judge.me) and its key name in operations/language-pulls.json, the key on the setup page

access.name: Customer surveys
access.unlocks: answers from buyers, refunds and leads
access.grant: each survey's response sheet in operations/language-pulls.json, shared with the brand's Drive service account

access.name: Interviews and calls
access.grant: an inbox folder in operations/language-pulls.json; drop transcripts there

access.name: Market data
access.unlocks: what is selling and what competitors run
access.grant: Kalodata or TrendTrack key on the setup page

steps.name: Name the avatar
steps.run: say "build the profile for <avatar> of <brand>" (avatar-profile skill)

steps.name: Connect the brand's own words
steps.run: grant at least one own-words source (see the access list)

steps.name: Find where he talks
steps.fills: the ### rooms block in profile.md (found by itself)

steps.name: Research round: what he watches
steps.run: say "run a research round for <avatar> of <brand>" (research-round skill)

steps.name: Research round: his problem
steps.fills: a second ranked round, on the problem
steps.run: say "run a problem round for <avatar> of <brand>" (research-round skill)

steps.name: Build the matrix
steps.run: say "build the matrix for <avatar> of <brand>" (research-round skill, step 7)

steps.name: Owner picks concepts
steps.fills: picks go to teardown and writing
steps.run: the owner picks on the matrix page
